title: summarize SKILL.md prompt rewrite — constraint-first structure + example output
description: Restructure skills/builtin/summarize/SKILL.md to maximize constraint adherence: move Constraints to top, use ALL CAPS emphasis, add [§N] as dedicated section, include worked example showing ≤30% length and [§N] citation format.
action: Rewrite skills/builtin/summarize/SKILL.md with: (1) Constraints section moved to position 1 (before Purpose); (2) ALL CAPS emphasis on MUST/MUST NOT rules; (3) [§N] citation rule as standalone subsection with format specification; (4) Example Output section demonstrating ≤30% length, [§N] citations, entity retention; (5) Preserve Working Principles, Common Patterns, Quality Bar sections in reordered form; (6) Keep 'Skill is a prompt package' philosophy — no code, no templates, no JSON schemas.

criteria: SKILL.md contains '## YOU MUST FOLLOW THESE RULES' as first section after title
SKILL.md contains 'OUTPUT LENGTH MUST BE ≤ 30% OF ORIGINAL' in ALL CAPS
SKILL.md contains 'CITATION FORMAT: [§N]' as standalone subsection
SKILL.md example output contains a length ratio statement (e.g. 'X%')
SKILL.md contains 'MUST retain all numbers, dates, names' — retained from original
SKILL.md still contains ## Purpose section (preserved, not deleted)
SKILL.md still contains ## Working Principles section (preserved, not deleted)
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 (no code changes, but verify build unaffected)
convergence.verification: grep patterns from criteria + npx tsc --noEmit
convergence.definition_of_done: SKILL.md rewritten with constraint-first structure, example output, ALL CAPS emphasis; no code changes; build passes.

files.change: Full content restructure: reorder sections, add emphasis, add example output

implementation: 1. Read current SKILL.md — preserve all existing content (Purpose, Working Principles, Constraints, Common Patterns, Quality Bar)
2. Apply section reorder: new order is (a) ALL CAPS Constraints, (b) [§N] Citation Format, (c) Purpose, (d) Working Principles, (e) Example Output, (f) Common Patterns, (g) Quality Bar

3. Rewrite Constraints with ALL CAPS: 'OUTPUT LENGTH MUST BE ≤ 30% OF ORIGINAL', 'YOU MUST RETAIN ALL numbers, dates, names, and quantitative claims', 'YOU MUST NOT introduce information absent from the source'
4. Add dedicated [§N] subsection: define format `[§{N}] {Claim} — {Evidence}`, explain that N=section number in source order
5. Add Example Output with concrete demonstration: show 3-4 [§1], [§2], [§3] lines, include length ratio line at end (e.g. 'Length: ~28% of original')
6. Preserve all original information — no deletions of meaningful content, only reorder and emphasize
7. Run npx tsc --noEmit to confirm zero build impact

commands: grep -c 'YOU MUST FOLLOW THESE RULES' skills/builtin/summarize/SKILL.md

rationale.chosen_approach: Content-only restructure with constraint-first order + ALL CAPS emphasis + worked example
decision_factors: Zero code change = zero risk to Runtime stability
ALL CAPS increases salience in system prompt processing
Example output demonstrates [§N] format concretely (examples > declarative rules)
Preserves all existing content — backward compatible in knowledge
rationale.tradeoffs: ALL CAPS may appear visually aggressive; acceptable tradeoff for increased compliance

risks.risk: ALL CAPS perceived as shouting by human readers of SKILL.md
risks.mitigation: Only used for 3-4 critical rules; rest of document in normal case

risks.risk: Section reorder confuses existing users familiar with old layout
risks.mitigation: SKILL.md is consumed by LLM, not directly read by users. Human audience is developers.
